subject.title: feat: add plugin verify evidence endpoint

question: Should this public plugin verify endpoint expose only selected-release evidence, or may it also expose mutable current package trusted-publisher and verification configuration?
rationale: This response can become an install/review automation contract for executable plugins, and the correct trust boundary depends on maintainer security/product intent rather than a purely mechanical code choice.

options.title: Require Release-Scoped Evidence
options.body: Proceed only if `provenance` contains facts attached to the selected release and mutable package configuration is omitted or moved elsewhere.

options.title: Expose Current Config Separately
options.body: Allow current trusted-publisher or package verification configuration only in a clearly named mutable-current-state field with docs and tests.

options.title: Pause For Trust RFC
options.body: Keep the draft paused until https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2272 settles public review-status and assurance semantics.

recommendation.title: Require Release-Scoped Evidence
recommendation.body: Proceed only if `provenance` contains facts attached to the selected release and mutable package configuration is omitted or moved elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the recent package trust API contributor and the collaborator who already offered to review this PR.
